title: Bound fifteen European indexed graphics archives
changes: Reconstruct all 1588 programs of fifteen original-reader indexed archives and establish their currently unowned source projections.
validation: Protected source plan dojboxqe reconstructs 143872 decoded bytes and 92304 source bytes in 29 spans without overlaps against E300.
limitations: Original execution for these streams, later dictionary tails, ordinary invocation, runtime integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
